In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]&mdash;[[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]]&mdash;launched a mission to '''rescue''' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|captured]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] and taken to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirates' stronghold]]. The younglings disguised as an [[Animal Instincts/Legends|Animal Instincts]] to rescue her and was successful, but the pirates led by [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]] begun to chase them. When they reached [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], they took off, but the ship's engines were shot by a [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]], it crashed, and the younglings and Tano were recaptured by the pirates.

==Prelude==
[[File:KenobiAndTheYounglings-BFR.png|thumb|left|250px|Kenobi instructs the Initiates not to attempt a rescue]]
{{Quote|We go to Florrum, Let the engine cools and rescue Ahsoka|[[Petro/Legends|Petro]]|<ref name="BFR" />}}
After being [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|attacked]] by Ohnaka and his pirates,<ref name="ATS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> the younglings were stranded and alone in the deep space.<ref name="BFR" /> [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]] was able to contacts [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi hailed the younglings and promised<ref name="BFR" /> to send [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]]<ref name="EP08Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep508|text="Bound for Rescue" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> to first pick up the younglings. However, Kenobi suffered a [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|surprise attack]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="BFR" /> and Kenobi was defeated.<ref name="ANB" /> Meanwhile, the younglings decided to disobey Kenobi's orders to stay where they were and went to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in order to rescue Tano on their own.<ref name="BFR" />

==The mission==
===The Infiltration===
{{Quote|Oh no.|Ahsoka Tano, upon recognizing the disguised Jedi Initiates|<ref name="BFR" />}}
Upon landing on Florrum, the Younglings except [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] set off their way towards the pirate base. On their way through the Florrum wastelands, the younglings happened to come across a traveling carnival troupe en route to Ohnaka's base to business. Petro saw an opportunity, claimed that he and the younglings<ref name="BFR" /> were junior acrobats<ref name="EP08Guide" /> and they managed to disguide as acrobats. [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]] then took them to the pirate base with the rest of his acrobats. When Preigo's troupe arrived later in the evening, Ohnaka joined the expectant audience under the company of Tano.

[[File:AnimalInstincts-BFR.png|thumb|right|250px|The Younglings infiltrated the Ohnaka's base as acrobats]]
The younglings appeared before Ohnaka, disguised, performed an entry act and finally get a drunken Ohnaka to join in on the next stunt. Unnoticed, Katooni stole [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|Tano's lightsabers]] and freed Tano. But as the younglings ran, they were recognized by the pirates and taken under fire, but they managed to steal<ref name="BFR" /> one of the [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]]<ref name="EP08Guide" /> and made their way to the ''Crucible''. As the Jedi head back to their ship, [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] contacted Ganodi to ready the ship for an immediate takeoff,<ref name="BFR" /> however, the pirates began to pursuit them across the wasteland.<ref name="ANB" />

===Pirates' pursuit===
While Tano and the younglings were returning<ref name="ANB" /> to the ''Crucible'',<ref name="BFR" /> a team of Ohnaka's [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] pirates led by [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]]<ref name="BFR" /> inside a [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]] begun to pursuit them across the wasteland. After some frantic attempts, Petro finally managed to contacts [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and Ganodi aboard the ''Crucible'', who had just restored [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]]<ref name="ANB" /> to an operative state<ref name="ANBEpisodeGuide">''{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep509|text="A Necessary Bond" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}''</ref> once more. Ganodi, R2-D2 and Huyang set off to aid their comrades at once, and attempted to pick them up in mid-run via the cruiser's boarding ramp. But in the midst of the evac attempt, their speeder raced to a ravine, forcing Petro to turn about, left [[Byph/Legends|Byph]] and [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] to hang precariously from the ramp. During a second attempt, however, the pirates managed to hit the cruiser's engines critically, forcing an immediate evacuation of the ''Crucible'' before it crashed down on the Florrum plains. As the ship was shot down, Tano and the Younglings were captured by the pirates.<ref name="ANB" />

==Aftermath==
After the ''Crucible'' crashed, Tano and the younglings were recaptured by the pirates. While Gwarm and his pirates returning to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|their outpost]],<ref name="ANB" /> General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], after defeating [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name="BFR" /> who the Younglings had been calling for help,<ref name="ATS" /> landed on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] and prepared to defeat Ohnaka's pirate gang and conquer the planet.<ref name="ANB" /> The Separatists sought revenge on Ohnaka,<ref name="ANBEpisodeGuide" /> because he had held Dooku, head of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], for ransom.<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>
